control_flow: followInTheDark: in dim light, if the line tracker reads below 90 % curve left, above 90 % curve right, otherwise call avoidWalls; in bright light call avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: in dim light, turn right on a left obstacle, turn left on a right obstacle, otherwise call driveInTheDark; in bright light call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: in dim light drive forward; in bright light call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: stop if an obstacle is ahead; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: on black curve left, otherwise curve right.
